# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `privos` skill, which drives the official `privos` CLI (`@privos_ai/privos`) for rooms, messages, files, lists, items, agents, and sandbox board projects and tasks.
- Writes are dry runs until the user confirms them.
- Logo: PrivOS brand mark (`assets/logo.svg`).
